notes: Glyphs 200-399 are NOT confirmed as the hiragana/katakana range.
Frequency analysis shows the highest-frequency Japanese characters (which must be hiragana particles) are at indices below 200.
The glyph sheet images are too low-resolution for reliable individual kana identification.
Individual glyph PNGs (glyphs_v3/) show glyphs 200-383 as nearly blank due to deswizzle issues.
The actual kana range is estimated to be approximately glyphs 94-345 (hiragana ~177-259, katakana ~260-345).
These estimates need confirmation via cross-reference analysis or fixed font atlas OCR.
